reusable_counterarguments.CE_gradient_relation: ∇x CE=-∇x log p_y, hence pairwise cosine invariant to this common sign change
reusable_counterarguments.response_projection: For d_mk=f_m(T_kG)-f_m(G), small perturbations give d_mk≈J_mδG_k; graph response vectors are projected sensitivity statistics
reusable_counterarguments.correctness_gate_nuisance_failure: Shared signal/nuisance representation with margins s±εn has gradient cosine (1-ε²)/(1+ε²). Both margins can remain positive; opposite nuisance dependence lowers pooled true-class sigmoid confidence by concavity. Correctness gating insufficient.
reusable_counterarguments.attention_irrelevance: For fixed message values, ∂o/∂b_e=a_e(t_e-o). Equal messages give same output under any attention map and zero score sensitivity.
reusable_counterarguments.perturbation_validity: Original correctness does not establish semantic label invariance or causal relevance of deleted edges/features
reusable_counterarguments.shared_parameter_boundary: Shared body changes feasible function family/combined regularizer gradients; does not invent input-gradient diversity or inherit independent-particle posterior guarantee

inactive_single_empirical_question.question: Does intervention-identity alignment add ordinary pooled quality beyond generic response repulsion under the same shared-body architecture?
inactive_single_empirical_question.matched_mechanism_control: Fixed member-specific permutations of intervention identities within otherwise identical graph-response objective; same response vectors/norms, forwards, own CE, views, architecture, initialization, labels, steps and selection budget; one prospective strength only
inactive_single_empirical_question.ordinary_quality_references: Regularizer-off shared ensemble, competent ordinary single, complete ordinary independent ensemble with matched paid capacity/compute/selection assumptions
inactive_single_empirical_question.failure: Stop if response diversity rises without better unperturbed heldout pooled quality, member degradation brings no collective recovery, or the permuted correspondence control gives the same quality gain
inactive_single_empirical_question.novelty: Any gain supports empirical utility or evidence-correspondence contribution; does not retroactively establish new sensitivity-diversity principle
